description:
Outcome: The coordinator receives one daily email listing new problem reports, from owner conversation.
Scope: Configured local send time and timezone, persistent digest batch/cursor, retry/deduplication, secure application links and delivery-failure visibility. Include reports since the last successful digest boundary even if resolved, labelled with status. Excludes: instant notifications, marketing and gardener contact details in email.
Acceptance: Each new report belongs to one logical daily batch; retries cannot lose or skip reports; empty days send nothing; missed runs catch up. Persist batch identity across retries. Confirm provider idempotency support before claiming duplicate-free delivery; document limitations if unsupported.
Behaviour: Scheduler downtime and provider errors preserve pending work, retry the same batch and expose actionable failure state without leaking secrets.
Verification: Fake-clock/provider boundary, timezone, resolved-report, downtime, crash/retry and idempotency tests. Prerequisites: T-009 and T-003. Assumptions: daily schedule configured by coordinator; logical batch uniqueness is separate from provider delivery guarantees.
title: Daily coordinator problem digest
